name: agent_state
description: Kiki's live state (listening, thinking, speaking, or idle) — the orb heartbeat.

name: set_stage
description: Fired BEFORE a tool call: advance the stage bar and light the relevant card so the 13-40s reasoning wait reads as intentional.

name: update_constraint
description: A constraint Kiki heard (dates, budget, kids, rooms, no early flights, weather) as a short human label plus a satisfied flag.

name: flight_options
description: The three flight options to render on the flight card, passed through from search_flights.

name: card_update
description: A booking tool returned for a vendor (flight, hotel, transport, or activities); the UI refetches /trip/status and re-renders that card.

name: trip_reflow
description: The whole trip moved to a new month via change_trip_dates; the UI pulses all cards and refetches everything.

name: payment_confirmed
description: Payment captured; the UI flips the payment card to paid and refetches the trip status.

name: user_picked_flight
description: The user tapped a flight option in the UI; Kiki confirms and books that flight.

name: user_removed_item
description: The user removed a vendor card in the UI; Kiki acknowledges it.
